requirement: Map a create-risk-factor command to a new RiskFactor model: copy the pathogen id, criterion id, and critical-factor flag, let the entity generate its id, and always report success without validating the referenced ids.

preconditions.text: The mapper is constructed without dependencies

inputs.text: Command with a pathogen id, criterion id, and critical-factor flag
Command mapped through the dependency overload
Command whose ids are not present in the database

returns.text: Success at ApplicationStatus.Success with a new RiskFactor
The pathogen id, criterion id, and critical-factor flag are copied
No id existence check is performed by the mapper

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the mapper always returns a successful result
